item.description: The _read_vol_str method in AuthSrv fails to properly validate volflag formats, particularly when parsing malformed volflags like "r.,u2". Currently, it raises "invalid volflag" errors for valid or semantically meaningful patterns.
item.contract: Update the _read_vol_str method to properly parse volflag strings that contain special characters like commas and dots. The method should correctly handle patterns such as "r.,u2" by treating them as valid permission specifications where "r." indicates read permission with a dot prefix and "u2" represents a username.
item.acceptance: test_dots.py::TestHttpCli::test should pass with the volflag pattern ".::r,u1:r.,u2"

item.description: The _parse_config_file method has incorrect validation logic for accs entries. It rejects valid permission specifications like "rwmdgGha: user1, user2, ..." due to overly restrictive parsing of permission lists.
item.contract: Fix the validation logic in _parse_config_file to correctly accept accs entries with comma-separated user lists. The method should properly parse permission specifications like "rwmdgGha: user1, user2, user3" without throwing "accs entries must be 'rwmdgGha: user1, user2, ...'" errors.
item.acceptance: test_idp.py::TestVFS::test_1 should pass with the accs entry format "r: ua" in the config file

item.description: The _parse_config_file method incorrectly rejects valid section headers, causing "invalid section header" exceptions when processing valid configuration sections.
item.contract: Update the section header validation logic to properly recognize valid section headers such as "[/volume]" and "[accounts]". The method should correctly parse configuration sections without raising "invalid section header" exceptions.
item.acceptance: test_idp.py::TestVFS::test_2 should pass with valid section headers in the config file

item.description: The _read_vol_str method does not properly handle the dotsrch flag for managing dotfile visibility in search results. This impacts the ability to configure proper dotfile handling in volume configurations.
item.contract: Enhance the _read_vol_str method to correctly process and store the dotsrch flag in volume configurations. The method should support proper handling of dotfile visibility settings for search results.
item.acceptance: test_dots.py::TestHttpCli::test should correctly handle dotfile visibility in search results when dotsrch flag is configured

item.description: The authentication and authorization logic for handling IdP user/group mappings and dynamic volume creation needs to be fixed to properly support the test scenarios in test_idp.py.
item.contract: Improve the AuthSrv class to correctly implement IdP user/group mapping and dynamic volume creation functionality. This includes properly handling the idp_checkin method and associated volume creation logic.
item.acceptance: test_idp.py::TestVFS::test_3, test_4, and test_5 should all pass with proper IdP user/group handling
